note: People seconds per outcome for run 2. Chosen and cited before run 2; never changed after it starts.

missed_harm.basis: USD 96 to correct one duplicate patient record, at the US median wage of a medical records specialist, USD 23.45 per hour: 96 / 23.45 h = 4.09 h = 14,737 s.
sources: Just BH, Marc D, Munns M, Sandefer R. Why Patient Matching Is a Challenge: Research on Master Patient Index (MPI) Data Discrepancies in Key Identifying Fields. Perspectives in Health Information Management. 2016;13(Spring):1e. PMID 27134610. PMC4832129. Cites USD 96 per duplicate record (Children's Medical Center Dallas).
U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wages, May 2023, 29-2072 Medical Records Specialists: median hourly wage USD 23.45. https://www.bls.gov/oes/2023/May/oes292072.htm
missed_harm.applies_to: every missed harmful change (wrong value, collateral change, missing or extra side record, duplicate). A wrong-chart or collateral correction is assumed to cost at least what a duplicate's does.

sensitivity.high_basis: USD 1,000 per duplicate pair (HIMSS 2014 panel, as reported by Healthcare IT News), at the same wage

caught_harm.basis: Modelled, not measured: no operator was timed. Cost model V1 (economic_comparison/assumptions.json): stop 90 + reconcile 120 + redo 180 + interrupt 30.

false_stop.basis: Modelled: stop 90 + interrupt 30 (the state is right, so no reconcile or redo).

failed_stop.basis: Modelled: stop 90 + interrupt 30 + reconcile 120 + redo 180 (the state is wrong).

silent_absent.basis: Modelled: the referral was never registered and nobody was told; reconcile 120 + redo 180 + interrupt 30 when it is found.
